other_failure_modes.name: Target leakage in Target Encoding
other_failure_modes.description: The agent precomputes Out-of-Fold (OOF) target encodings before the cross-validation loop and uses them as static features. This leaks validation fold targets into the training fold features, because the OOF encoding for a training row was calculated using the target values of the validation rows. Target encoding must be computed dynamically inside the CV loop using only the current fold's training data.

other_failure_modes.name: Full-batch inference causing Out-of-Memory (OOM)
other_failure_modes.description: The agent passes the entire validation and test sets into the PyTorch neural network at once without using a DataLoader for batching. For large datasets, this will immediately cause a CUDA Out-Of-Memory RuntimeError, crashing the script.

other_failure_modes.name: Categorical features treated as continuous in Neural Network
other_failure_modes.description: The agent label-encodes categorical variables into arbitrary integers and applies StandardScaler, treating them as continuous numerical features in the PyTorch TabularResNet. Neural networks cannot meaningfully process arbitrary integer labels as continuous floats without embedding layers, severely degrading performance.

summary: The agent implements a sophisticated ensemble of tree models and a TabularResNet but introduces severe data leakage. Random KFold splitting on panel data leaks future information, and precomputing OOF target encodings before the CV loop leaks validation targets into training features. Additionally, full-batch inference in PyTorch likely causes a CUDA OOM crash, and categorical variables are inappropriately treated as continuous floats in the neural network.
